subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should OpenClaw expose skill-authored dashboard configuration actions from `SKILL.md`, and if so what URL trust policy and metadata shape should be public?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically bounded, but the durable decision is a public skill metadata/API contract plus a dashboard URL security boundary that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Add typed config action
options.body: Expose a maintainer-approved metadata shape for configuration actions and require the dashboard to route it through the shared safe-URL policy with tests and docs.

options.title: Reuse existing surfaces
options.body: Decline new fields for now and direct skills to use `homepage`, Skill Cards, or ClawHub metadata until a broader plugin settings model exists.

options.title: Defer to plugin settings design
options.body: Keep the request open but block implementation until maintainers define a general plugin or skill settings entry-point contract.

recommendation.title: Add typed config action
recommendation.body: Expose a maintainer-approved metadata shape for configuration actions and require the dashboard to route it through the shared safe-URL policy with tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: The likely decision crosses skill metadata, docs, and dashboard URL safety, and this history shows recent work across those shared boundaries.
